world.title: President Hassan Sheikh Graduates SNA Troops in Galgaduud as Government Expands Counter
world.desc: XANANBUURE — President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, who also serves as the Commander-in-Chief of the Somali Armed Forces, has presided over the graduation ceremony of new Somali National Army troops at the Xananbuure military training facility in the Galgaduud region. The ceremony was attended by Galmudug President Ahmed Abdi Kariye (Qoor-Qoor), Defence Minister Ahmed Moallim Fiqi, Somali National Army Commander Major General Ibrahim Mohamed Mohamud, members of parliament, military officials, and other dignitaries. The graduating troops presented a military parade and demonstrated their combat skills during the ceremony. The graduation comes as the Federal Government continues to expand and professionalise the Somali National Army to assume greater responsibility for national security as the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) faces an uncertain future. The government has been intensifying military operations against Al-Shabaab in central and southern Somalia, with the Galgaduud region serving as a key staging ground for counter-terrorism operations. The Somali National Army and AUSSOM have been working to expedite the implementation of the Security Transition Plan to facilitate the transfer of security responsibilities to Somali forces. The SNA Commander has emphasized the importance of structural and institutional reforms within the national army to ensure a professional, disciplined force capable of defending the country without heavy external reliance. Somali forces have intensified operations against Al-Shabaab in the Lower Shabelle region, with recent operations killing 22 militants including a commander. Expanding Security Capacity The graduation ceremony is part of broader efforts to build Somalia’s security capacity. The Federal Government has been working to professionalise the Somali National Army, with support from international partners including Turkey, the United States, and the African Union. The government has identified the development of a capable and professional national army as a priority in its National Transformation Plan. The TURKSOM Military Academy in […]
